effects: POL (0x455e…) leaves the signer: about _amount, pulled by the StakeManager (0x5e3e…) through transferFrom, which uses up the signer's existing POL allowance to it.
The signer gets validator share tokens (dPOL, the proxy contract itself), at least _minSharesToMint, at the validator's exchange rate.
Before the deposit, any pending delegation rewards are paid out to the signer in POL (Polygon ValidatorShare._buyVoucher calls _withdrawAndTransferReward). The implementation is not in the directory.
formats.shown: Stake POL, with the stake amount in POL and a raw minimum share count.

findings.title: buyVoucherPOL: 'Min shares' is raw with no decimals or token, and 0 means no slippage protection.
findings.evidence: descriptor: {"path":"#._minSharesToMint","label":"Min shares","format":"raw"}. Case 0 shows 'Min shares: 0', but 113820189659605384342 dPOL57 (18 decimals) were minted to the signer.
findings.fix: Use format tokenAmount with tokenPath "@.to" (the share token is the validator contract), label it 'Min shares received', and set a threshold or message for 0 (no minimum).

findings.title: buyVoucherPOL: pending rewards are paid to the signer before staking, and the screen never says so.
findings.evidence: Polygon ValidatorShare._buyVoucher calls _withdrawAndTransferReward(msg.sender, pol) before _buyShares. That source is not in the directory. Case 0 had no pending rewards, so no transfer was mined.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Stake POL (claims pending rewards)', or add an interpolatedIntent that says so.

findings.title: buyVoucherPOL: the transfer spends an existing POL allowance to the StakeManager, and the screen does not mention it.
findings.evidence: Case 0 mined: an approval event on POL from the signer to 0x5e3ef299…, with remaining allowance 340394615658 (signer 'grant'), emitted by the transferFrom of 113.82 POL.
findings.fix: None needed. This is the prerequisite of the stated stake.

findings.title: buyVoucherPOL: there is no interpolatedIntent, so the amount is missing from the summary line.

cases.notes: The POL out amount and asset are right. The shares in are shown only as raw min 0, so the reader knew a position arrives but not how much. The allowance spend is not on screen.

effects: Up to maximumSharesToBurn validator share tokens (dPOL) are burned from the signer.
An unbond request (new nonce) is created for claimAmount POL. The POL is claimable only after the unbonding delay, not in this transaction.
Pending delegation rewards are paid to the signer in POL right away (_withdrawAndTransferReward).
formats.shown: Unstake POL, with 'Claim amount' in POL and a raw 'Max shares' number.

findings.title: sellVoucher_newPOL: pending POL rewards are paid to the signer, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: Case 1 mined: 66050895952657124 POL moved from the StakeManager 0x5e3e… to the signer (signer 'in'). Screen: intent 'Unstake POL', fields 'Claim amount' and 'Max shares' only. The blind reader expected nothing to arrive now.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Unstake POL and claim rewards', or an interpolatedIntent such as 'Unstake {claimAmount} and withdraw pending rewards'.

findings.title: sellVoucher_newPOL: 'Claim amount' suggests POL arrives now, but it only enters the unbonding queue.
findings.evidence: descriptor label 'Claim amount' on #.claimAmount. In case 1 the 113.82 POL did not move. It was received later in case 2 through unstakeClaimTokens_newPOL.
findings.fix: Label it 'Amount to unbond (claimable after unbonding period)', or add an interpolatedIntent that says the POL must be claimed later.

findings.title: sellVoucher_newPOL: 'Max shares' is shown as a raw 21-digit integer.
findings.evidence: descriptor: {"path":"#.maximumSharesToBurn","format":"raw"}. Case 1 screen: 'Max shares: 113820189659605384342'. Mined: 113820189659605384342 dPOL57 burned.
findings.fix: Use format tokenAmount with tokenPath "@.to" and the label 'Max shares burned'.

cases.notes: The reward payout of 0.066 POL is not on screen. The shares burned are right as a raw bound.

effects: The unbond request unbondNonce of the signer is closed, and its stored POL amount is paid from the StakeManager to the signer.
formats.shown: Claim unstaked POL for unbond nonce N.

findings.title: unstakeClaimTokens_newPOL: the amount of POL received comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Case 2 mined: 113820189659605384342 POL in to the signer. The screen shows only 'Unbond nonce: 1'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The amount is stored in unbonds_new[msg.sender][nonce].

cases.notes: The asset and direction are right. The amount cannot be shown.

effects: All of the signer's accrued delegation rewards are paid out in POL from the StakeManager to the signer, and the reward checkpoint is reset.
formats.shown: Withdraw POL rewards, with no fields.

findings.title: withdrawRewardsPOL: the reward amount comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Case 3 mined: 7315038061352272818512 POL in to the signer. Screen fields: [].

cases.notes: The direction and asset are right. The amount cannot be shown.

couldNotCheck: The ValidatorShare implementation is not in the directory. ValidatorShareProxy.loadImplementation() returns Registry(...).getValidatorShareAddress(), but meta.json resolves the implementation to the Registry itself, so the code of buyVoucherPOL, sellVoucher_newPOL, unstakeClaimTokens_newPOL and withdrawRewardsPOL is missing.
The StakeManager (0x5e3ef299fddf15eaa0432e6e66473ace8c13d908) is not in the directory. It pulls the POL deposit and pays out unbonded funds and rewards.
